headline: DU Senate session: DUCSU members walk out over name changes
summary: Five DUCSU representatives staged a walkout during a Senate session after the university administration failed to decide on renaming five campus installations named after the Sheikh family.
details: Five members of the Dhaka University Central Students' Union (DUCSU) walked out of a Senate session on Monday night in protest against the university's failure to rename five installations named after the Sheikh family.

The Vice-Chancellor, Professor A B M Obul Islam, sought the Senate's opinion on renaming the Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman Hall, Sheikh Fazilatunnessa Mujib Hall, Russell Tower, Bangabandhu Tower, and Sultana Kamal Hostel.

However, a Senate member, Professor Lutfor Rahman, argued that the decision should first be approved by the Syndicate, following university rules, which the Vice-Chancellor confirmed had not yet happened.
DUCSU VP Abu Sadik Kayem and GS SM Farhad demanded that the decision to rename be made immediately during the session, arguing that students are being victimized by the current names.

VP Abu Sadik Kayem cited instances where students from Sheikh Mujibur Rahman Hall were allegedly harassed by police at the National Martyrs' Memorial and faced funding issues for their debate club due to the name.
When the Vice-Chancellor stated that the matter would be taken to the Syndicate for a formal process, the five DUCSU members—including the VP, GS, and AGS—staged their walkout in protest.
The protesting members included VP Abu Sadik Kayem, GS SM Farhad, AGS Muha. Mohiuddin, Transport Secretary Asif Abdullah, and Executive Member Sabikunnahar Tamanna.

However, a Senate member, Professor Lutfor Rahman, argued that the decision should first be approved by the Syndicate, following university rules, which the Vice-Chancellor confirmed had not yet happened.

DUCSU VP Abu Sadik Kayem and GS SM Farhad demanded that the decision to rename be made immediately during the session, arguing that students are being victimized by the current names.

VP Abu Sadik Kayem cited instances where students from Sheikh Mujibur Rahman Hall were allegedly harassed by police at the National Martyrs' Memorial and faced funding issues for their debate club due to the name.

When the Vice-Chancellor stated that the matter would be taken to the Syndicate for a formal process, the five DUCSU members—including the VP, GS, and AGS—staged their walkout in protest.

headline: No casualties as bus catches fire on Dhaka-Mawa Expressway
summary: An Evergreen Paribahan bus burst into flames on Kuchiamora Bridge late Monday night, but all passengers escaped safely.
details: A Mawa-bound Evergreen Paribahan bus coming from Gulistan caught fire on the Kuchiamora Bridge in Shirajdikhan, Munshiganj, around 11:00 PM on Monday night.
Two units from the Shirajdikhan Fire Station were dispatched to the scene and brought the blaze under control shortly after being notified.
According to Muhammad Shafiqul Islam, Deputy Assistant Director of Munshiganj Fire Service and Civil Defence, the fire may have been caused by a mechanical or electrical malfunction.
Passengers were able to evacuate the vehicle quickly and safely immediately after the fire broke out, resulting in no casualties reported.
caption:
A bus burst into flames on the Dhaka-Mawa Expressway late Monday night, but all passengers escaped safely.

A Mawa-bound Evergreen Paribahan bus coming from Gulistan caught fire on the Kuchiamora Bridge in Shirajdikhan, Munshiganj, around 11:00 PM on Monday night.

Two units from the Shirajdikhan Fire Station were dispatched to the scene and brought the blaze under control shortly after being notified.

According to Muhammad Shafiqul Islam, Deputy Assistant Director of Munshiganj Fire Service and Civil Defence, the fire may have been caused by a mechanical or electrical malfunction.

Passengers were able to evacuate the vehicle quickly and safely immediately after the fire broke out, resulting in no casualties reported.
